nutrition_source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy (April 2018 release); spices, salt and herbs listed without grams are excluded as negligible

goal_cutoffs.lose_weight: <=500 kcal and >=20 g protein per serving

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
recipes.summary: Smoky shredded chicken in a chipotle tomato sauce, piled on warm corn tortillas.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water for 15–18 minutes, until it reaches 165°F inside. Shred with two forks.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, chipotle and oregano. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add the shredded chicken and simmer 5 more minutes. Season with salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with chicken, avocado, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Seasoned ground turkey with black beans and salsa in crisp romaine cups.

ingredients.text: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.usda_description: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains (165°F).
Stir in the chili powder, cumin and a pinch of salt.
Add the black beans and salsa. Simmer 3–4 minutes until warmed through.
Spoon into romaine leaves and top with tomato and cheddar.

recipes.name: Steak Burrito Bowls
recipes.summary: Seared flank steak over rice and beans with corn, salsa and avocado.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, flank, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 0" fat, select, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt
Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels cut off cob, boiled, drained, without salt

ingredients.text: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, salt

steps: Rub the steak with the oil, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Sear in a hot skillet 4–5 minutes per side to at least 145°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Warm the beans and corn.
Divide the rice into bowls and top with steak, beans, corn, salsa, cheese and avocado. Finish with lime.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Enchiladas
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potato and black beans rolled in tortillas and baked in red sauce.

ingredients.usda_description: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the sweet potato with the oil and salt and roast 20 minutes until tender.
Mix the tomato sauce with the chili powder and cumin.
Combine the sweet potato, beans and onion. Fill each tortilla and roll.
Place seam-side down in a baking dish, pour the sauce over and top with cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling. Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
recipes.summary: Shrimp, peppers and onions roasted on one pan and wrapped in warm tortillas.

ingredients.text: 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the peppers and onion with 1 tbsp oil and half the spices. Roast 10 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the rest of the oil and spices. Add to the pan and roast 6–8 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Squeeze lime over everything.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

recipes.name: Pork Carnitas Rice Plate
recipes.summary: Crispy citrus pork with rice, beans and cheese. A big, filling plate.

ingredients.usda_description: Pork, fresh, loin, center loin (chops), boneless, separable lean only, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt

steps: Toss the pork with the lime juice, cumin, oregano and salt.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high. Brown the pork in batches until crisp outside and 145°F inside, about 8–10 minutes.
Add the onion for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the beans. Plate the rice, beans and pork, then top with cheese, avocado and salsa.

recipes.name: Chicken & Cheese Quesadillas
recipes.summary: Golden flour tortillas packed with chicken, peppers and melted cheese.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Season the chicken with the chili powder and salt. Cook in half the oil over medium heat, 6–7 minutes per side, to 165°F. Slice.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese, chicken and pepper. Fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Street Corn Chicken Salad
recipes.summary: Charred corn, grilled chicken and crisp romaine with a lime-yogurt dressing.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels cut off cob, boiled, drained, without salt
Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Season the chicken with the chili powder and salt. Cook in half the oil over medium heat to 165°F, then slice.
Char the corn in the remaining oil in a hot skillet, 4–5 minutes.
Whisk the yogurt and lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Toss the romaine with the dressing and top with chicken, corn, feta and cilantro.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatball Marinara
recipes.summary: Tender baked turkey meatballs simmered in marinara over spaghetti.

ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan, half the garlic, seasoning and salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Bake on a lined sheet 15–18 minutes, to 165°F inside.
Warm the oil in a pot, add the rest of the garlic for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs to the sauce. Cook the spaghetti and serve topped with sauce, meatballs and basil.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
recipes.summary: Crisp-baked chicken topped with marinara and melted mozzarella, served with pasta.

ingredients.text: 1¾ lb chicken breast, halved into cutlets
ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Season the cutlets, dredge in flour, dip in egg, then press in parmesan.
Brown in the oil 2 minutes per side, then move to a baking dish.
Spoon the sauce over and top with mozzarella. Bake 15 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the cheese bubbles.
Serve over the cooked spaghetti with extra sauce.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Zoodles
recipes.summary: Light, bright shrimp with zucchini noodles, garlic, lemon and parmesan.

ingredients.usda_description: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook the garlic and pepper flakes 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Add the zucchini noodles and toss 2 minutes, just until tender.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and parmesan.

recipes.name: Spinach Ricotta Baked Pasta
recipes.summary: Pasta baked with creamy ricotta, spinach, marinara and mozzarella.

ingredients.text: 8 oz dry pasta shells (about 4 cups cooked)
ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the pasta 2 minutes short of the package time and drain.
Wilt the spinach in a dry pan and chop. Mix with the ricotta, egg, parmesan and salt.
Toss the pasta with the ricotta mixture and half the sauce. Spread in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining sauce and the mozzarella. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
recipes.summary: A hearty bowl of pasta tossed with basil pesto, chicken and tomatoes.

ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the pasta, saving ½ cup of the pasta water.
Season the chicken and cook in the oil over medium heat 6–7 minutes per side to 165°F. Slice.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, a splash of pasta water, the chicken and tomatoes.
Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Hearty Beef Lasagna Skillet
recipes.summary: All the lasagna flavor in one pan: beef, tomato, pasta and three cheeses.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, ground, 85% lean meat / 15% fat, raw (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.text: 12 oz dry wide pasta (about 6 cups cooked)
ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt

steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large deep skillet until no pink remains (160°F). Drain the fat. Add the garlic.
Stir in the tomatoes, seasoning and 1 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta. Dot with spoonfuls of ricotta, then sprinkle the mozzarella and parmesan over the top.
Cover and cook on low 5 minutes until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Tuscan Chicken with Beans & Spinach
recipes.summary: Pan-seared chicken in a garlicky tomato sauce with white beans and spinach.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

ingredients.text: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas or white beans, drained
ingredients.usda_description: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

steps: Season the chicken and sear in the oil over medium-high heat, 5–6 minutes per side, to 165°F. Set aside.
Add the garlic to the pan for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes, beans and seasoning. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Slice the chicken, return it to the pan and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
recipes.summary: Quick naan pizzas with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.

ingredients.usda_description: Bread, naan, plain, commercially prepared, refrigerated
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

ingredients.text: Pinch salt, ½ tsp dried oregano

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Spread the sauce on the naan, sprinkle with oregano, and top with mozzarella and tomato slices.
Bake 8–10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling.
Drizzle with oil and top with basil.

recipes.name: Ginger Beef & Broccoli
recipes.summary: Tender sirloin and crisp broccoli in a glossy ginger-soy sauce over rice.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, top sirloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, select, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt

steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and ½ cup water.
Heat half the oil in a wok over high heat. Sear the beef 2–3 minutes until browned (145°F). Remove.
Add the rest of the oil and the broccoli with 2 tbsp water. Cover and steam 3 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then the beef and sauce. Toss until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowls
recipes.summary: Glazed salmon with brown rice, edamame, cucumber and avocado.

ingredients.usda_description: Rice, brown, long-grain, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.text: Sesame seeds and sliced scallions to serve

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brush the salmon with half the teriyaki.
Bake 12–15 minutes, until it flakes and reaches 145°F. Brush with the rest of the sauce.
Cook the edamame according to the package.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado. Top with sesame seeds and scallions.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.summary: Classic weeknight fried rice with chicken, egg, peas and carrots.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt
Peas, green, frozen, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the cooking oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the chicken 5–6 minutes until 165°F. Remove.
Scramble the eggs in the wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the carrots 2 minutes, then the garlic and peas for 1 minute.
Add the rice and press it flat to crisp, 3 minutes. Stir in the chicken, eggs, soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Peanut Chicken Noodles
recipes.summary: Rice noodles in a creamy peanut-lime sauce with chicken and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.text: 8 oz dry rice noodles (about 4½ cups cooked)

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Peanuts, all types, dry-roasted, without salt

steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, honey and ¼ cup hot water until smooth.
Cook the chicken in the oil over medium heat 6–7 minutes per side to 165°F. Slice.
Cook the noodles according to the package and rinse.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, vegetables and chicken. Top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Golden tofu with broccoli, peppers and snap peas in a garlic-soy glaze.

ingredients.text: 14 oz firm tofu, pressed and cubed
ingredients.usda_description: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate
Rice, brown, long-grain, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Toss the tofu with 1 tbsp cornstarch. Fry in 1½ tbsp oil over medium-high heat until golden on all sides, 8–10 minutes. Remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the remaining oil 4 minutes.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, garlic, the rest of the cornstarch and ¼ cup water. Add to the pan and simmer until thick.
Return the tofu, toss and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Sweet-savory ground beef over rice with quick cucumbers and a fried egg.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, ground, 93% lean meat / 7% fat, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt

steps: Brown the beef in a skillet until no pink remains (160°F). Drain any fat.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil. Simmer 2 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites and yolks are firm.
Serve the beef over rice with cucumber and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Shrimp Pad Thai
recipes.summary: Tangy rice noodles with shrimp, egg, bean sprouts and peanuts.

ingredients.text: 8 oz dry rice noodles (about 4½ cups cooked)

ingredients.usda_description: Peanuts, all types, dry-roasted, without salt

steps: Soak or cook the noodles according to the package.
Whisk the soy sauce, sugar and juice of 1 lime.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the shrimp and garlic 2–3 minutes until opaque. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes. Add the sprouts and scallions.
Top with peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken & Rice
recipes.summary: Sticky honey-garlic chicken thighs with green beans and a big scoop of rice.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, cooked, enriched, with salt

steps: Season the thighs and brown in the oil over medium-high heat, 5 minutes per side.
Add the garlic, honey and soy sauce. Simmer, turning, until the sauce is sticky and the chicken reaches 165°F, about 8 minutes.
Steam the green beans and toss with the butter.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice with green beans.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Sweet Potato Bowl
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potatoes, BBQ chicken, black beans and a crunchy slaw.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato with the oil, paprika and salt. Roast 25 minutes.
Bake the chicken on another pan 20–22 minutes to 165°F, brushing with BBQ sauce for the last 5 minutes. Slice.
Toss the cabbage with the yogurt, lime juice and salt.
Build bowls with sweet potato, beans, chicken and slaw.

recipes.name: Classic Smash Burgers
recipes.summary: Crispy-edged beef patties with melted cheddar on whole-wheat buns, plus oven fries.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, ground, 85% lean meat / 15% fat, raw (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Rolls, hamburger or hot dog, whole wheat
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Pickles, cucumber, dill or kosher dill

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potato wedges with the oil and salt and roast 30 minutes, flipping once.
Form the beef into 8 loose balls. Smash each flat on a very hot skillet and season.
Cook 2–3 minutes until crusty, flip, add cheese to half of them and cook 1 more minute (160°F).
Stack 2 patties per bun with lettuce, tomato, pickles, ketchup and mustard. Serve with the fries.

recipes.name: Hearty Turkey Chili
recipes.summary: A thick, high-protein chili with turkey, two kinds of beans and tomatoes.

ingredients.usda_description: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, salt
½ cup shredded cheddar to top
ingredients.usda_description: Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion and pepper 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the turkey and cook until no pink remains (165°F).
Stir in the spices, tomatoes, beans and 1 cup water. Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Season with salt and top each bowl with cheddar.

recipes.name: Chicken Broccoli Mac & Cheese
recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop mac and cheese loaded with chicken and broccoli.

ingredients.text: 10 oz dry elbow pasta (about 5 cups cooked)
ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Cook the chicken in the oil over medium heat until 165°F. Set aside.
Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the cheddar, mustard and salt. Fold in the pasta, broccoli and chicken.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Salmon, Potatoes & Asparagus
recipes.summary: Lemony salmon roasted on one pan with baby potatoes and asparagus.

ingredients.usda_description: Potatoes, red, flesh and skin, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast 15 minutes.
Add the asparagus and salmon to the pan. Brush with the rest of the oil, garlic, lemon juice and dill.
Roast 12–15 minutes until the salmon reaches 145°F.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
recipes.summary: Spicy chicken, crisp lettuce and a cool yogurt ranch rolled in tortillas.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.text: 3 tbsp hot sauce, ½ tsp garlic powder, dried dill, salt

steps: Cook the chicken in the oil over medium heat 6–7 minutes per side to 165°F. Slice and toss with hot sauce.
Mix the yogurt with garlic powder, dill, salt and a splash of water.
Fill the tortillas with romaine, carrot, chicken and sauce, then roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Steak & Potatoes
recipes.summary: Pan-seared sirloin with crispy garlic potatoes and green beans.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, top sirloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, select, raw
Potatoes, red, flesh and skin, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with the oil and salt and roast 25–30 minutes.
Season the steak. Sear in a hot skillet 4–5 minutes per side to at least 145°F.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and spoon over the steak for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Sauté the green beans in the same pan. Serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie Skillet
recipes.summary: A creamy chicken and vegetable filling under flaky biscuit-style dumplings.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Peas, green, frozen, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter in an oven-safe skillet. Cook the onion and carrots 5 minutes. Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in 3 tbsp flour, then the broth and ½ cup milk. Simmer until thick and add the peas.
Mix the rest of the flour, the baking powder, salt, 2 tbsp melted butter and ½ cup milk into a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls on top. Bake at 400°F for 18–20 minutes until golden and the filling reaches 165°F.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Sheet Pan with Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Oregano-lemon chicken roasted with peppers, onion and zucchini, served with tzatziki.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chicken and vegetables with the oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan 20–25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Mix the yogurt, squeezed cucumber, 1 grated garlic clove, dill and salt.
Serve the chicken and vegetables with tzatziki.

recipes.name: Baked Chickpea Falafel Bowls
recipes.summary: Oven-baked falafel bites over quinoa with cucumber, tomato and tahini.

ingredients.usda_description: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Seeds, sesame butter, tahini, from roasted and toasted kernels (most common type)

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, salt and flour until coarse.
Shape into 20 small patties, brush with the oil and bake 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until pourable.
Build bowls with quinoa, chopped cucumber and tomato, and falafel. Drizzle with tahini.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Salmon & Couscous
recipes.summary: Flaky salmon on fluffy couscous with tomatoes, olives and feta.

ingredients.usda_description: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Season the salmon with salt, pepper and lemon zest. Bake 12–15 minutes to 145°F.
Toss the couscous with the tomatoes, olives, oil, lemon juice and parsley.
Top with feta and the salmon.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Pitas
recipes.summary: Spiced roasted chicken thighs stuffed in pitas with tomato, cucumber and garlic yogurt.

ingredients.usda_description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

ingredients.text: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp turmeric, garlic, salt

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon juice and spices.
Roast 20–25 minutes to 165°F, then slice.
Mix the yogurt with grated garlic and salt.
Spread the pitas with hummus and fill with chicken, vegetables and garlic yogurt.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: A cozy, fiber-rich soup with lentils, carrots, tomatoes and spinach.

ingredients.usda_description: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

ingredients.text: 6 cups vegetable broth or water, 2 tsp cumin, salt

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion and carrots 6 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin.
Add the rinsed dry lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 25–30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and finish with lemon juice and salt.

recipes.name: Greek Turkey Meatball Bowls
recipes.summary: Herby turkey meatballs with brown rice, hummus, cucumber and feta.

ingredients.usda_description: Rice, brown, long-grain, cooked (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, egg, half the feta, oregano, garlic powder and salt. Roll into 20 balls.
Bake 15–18 minutes to 165°F.
Build bowls with rice, spinach, cucumber, tomato and meatballs. Add a scoop of hummus and the rest of the feta.

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp with Tomatoes & Feta
recipes.summary: Shrimp baked in a garlicky tomato sauce with feta, served over pasta.

ingredients.text: 8 oz dry orzo or small pasta (about 4 cups cooked)
ingredients.usda_description: Pasta, cooked, enriched, without added salt

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Warm the oil in an oven-safe skillet and cook the garlic 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and pepper flakes. Simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the spinach.
Nestle in the shrimp, crumble the feta over and bake 10–12 minutes until the shrimp are opaque.
Serve over the cooked pasta.

recipes.name: Loaded Hummus Power Plate
recipes.summary: A big snack-style plate of hummus, chickpeas, vegetables, feta and warm pita.

ingredients.usda_description: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Spread the hummus on a plate and top with the chickpeas, oil and paprika.
Cut the vegetables into sticks and wedges.
Warm the pitas and cut into triangles.
Arrange everything with the feta and olives.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Oat Parfait
recipes.summary: Layers of creamy Greek yogurt, fresh berries, granola and honey.

ingredients.usda_description: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into two glasses.
Add berries, then granola and chia.
Repeat the layers and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Spinach & Feta Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Fluffy eggs and egg whites with spinach and feta, plus whole-wheat toast.
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Wilt the spinach in the oil over medium heat.
Add the eggs and stir gently until just set and no longer runny.
Top with feta and serve with toast.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: No-cook oats soaked overnight with milk, banana and peanut butter. A big, filling breakfast.

ingredients.usda_description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Mix the oats, milk, chia and honey in two jars.
Swirl in the peanut butter and half of one mashed banana.
Refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with the rest of the sliced banana in the morning.

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy oat pancakes made with cottage cheese and eggs, topped with berries.

ingredients.usda_description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

ingredients.text: 1 tsp baking powder, pinch salt, cinnamon

steps: Blend the oats, cottage cheese, eggs, banana, baking powder, salt and cinnamon until smooth.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour ¼-cup scoops and cook 2 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Top with blueberries and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Big Breakfast Burritos
recipes.summary: Scrambled eggs, potatoes, turkey sausage-style crumbles and cheese in large tortillas.

ingredients.usda_description: Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ingredients.text: 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp sage, salt

steps: Cook the diced potatoes in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat, covered, 10–12 minutes until tender and crisp.
Brown the turkey with paprika, sage and salt until it reaches 165°F.
Scramble the eggs in the rest of the oil until set.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, potatoes, turkey, cheese and salsa, then roll.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
recipes.summary: Whole-wheat toast with smashed avocado, eggs and a squeeze of lemon.

ingredients.usda_description: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt and spread on the toast.
Fry or poach the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
Top the toast with eggs, sliced tomato and pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Muffins
recipes.summary: Make-ahead baked egg cups with peppers, spinach and cheese.

ingredients.usda_description: Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and pepper.
Divide the vegetables and cheese among the cups, then pour in the eggs.
Bake 20–22 minutes until set in the center.

recipes.name: Berry Banana Protein Smoothie
recipes.summary: A thick, quick smoothie with berries, banana, Greek yogurt and protein powder.

ingredients.usda_description: Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth, adding ice for a thicker shake.
Pour into two glasses.

recipes.name: Steak & Egg Potato Hash
recipes.summary: A hearty skillet of crispy potatoes, sirloin, peppers and fried eggs.

ingredients.usda_description: Beef, top sirloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, select, raw
Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Cook the potatoes in 1½ tbsp oil, covered, over medium heat 12 minutes until tender, then uncover to crisp.
Add the pepper, onion and steak. Cook 4–5 minutes until the steak reaches 145°F.
Make 4 wells, add the rest of the oil and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites and yolks are firm.
Top with cheese and paprika.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Protein Oatmeal
recipes.summary: Warm oatmeal cooked in milk with apple, cinnamon, walnuts and a protein boost.

ingredients.usda_description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

steps: Simmer the oats, milk, apple, cinnamon and salt 5–6 minutes, stirring.
Take off the heat and stir in the protein powder with a splash of milk if thick.
Top with walnuts and maple syrup.
